name: Mesa
description: Open source implementations of OpenGL, Vulkan and other graphics APIs.
summary: AI-assisted code is allowed if the submitter understands it, takes responsibility including MIT licence compatibility, and discloses AI involvement with Assisted-by or Generated-by. Autonomous tools may not submit or interact with issues or MRs, and AI should not write comments, commit messages or GitLab comments.

evidence.quote: That responsibility includes making sure that the code change can be submitted under the MIT license that Mesa uses.
Disclosure is always required when "AI" was involved in the creative process of coming up with the code, except in the following cases:
It is not allowed to use autonomously acting tools to submit any contributions, that is every contributions needs explicit oversight and your review.
This includes interactions with GitLab issues or MRs in any autonomous way through such tools.
"AI" shouldn't be used to generate code comments, commit messages, and Gitlab comments.
Consequentially, contributors can use "AI" for research etc., but all text should be their own words.
